items.title: LTM Final Capstone
items.description: An industrial AI assistant for plant operators, maintenance engineers, and shift supervisors. The project includes a Manufacturing Plant Monitoring & Diagnostics Assistant built with Mistral + LangChain + FAISS RAG. It features 8 tabs in the Streamlit UI, providing sensors, log data, fault diagnosis, parts catalog lookup, PM schedule, knowledge base query, log analysis, safety checks, OEE production KPIs, and system health checks.

items.title: Weather Dashboard Microservices Architecture
items.description: A modern, full-stack weather application built with Flask microservices, featuring JWT authentication, real-time weather data, and a beautiful animated UI. The application consists of three independent services: an API Gateway, an Authentication Service, and a Weather Service.

items.title: Code Auditor Copilot CLI Agnet
items.description: This project provides a custom agent for CodeAudit to scan for security and production readiness issues in code repositories. It uses GitHub Copilot's capabilities to review code and identify areas for improvement, while also providing detailed reports on the findings.

items.title: Clothing Store Full Stack Using Node
items.description: This is a full-stack clothing e-commerce application built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, and SQLite during the development phase. The focus of this project is real-world application development, not just UI — including backend APIs, database design, cart logic, orders, and debugging real issues that arise when frontend and backend interact.

items.title: N8n And Backend LLM DB Maps Agent
items.description: The project consists of two main components: the Python backend and the n8n workflow editor. The Python backend is responsible for classifying Google Maps reviews with a local LLM (Ollama) and returning a structured output containing sentiment and suggested replies. The n8n workflow editor allows users to create workflows that integrate with the Python backend, enabling businesses to automate tasks such as data analysis and reporting.

items.title: Azure App Host CI CD Pipeline
items.description: This project involves hosting a web application using Azure DevOps and implementing Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. The primary language used is CSS, along with HTML and JavaScript. This project is part of a portfolio.

items.title: Multi Channel Support System
items.description: A real-time, multi-tenant support-triage platform that ingests support requests from Discord and Gmail, classifies criticality with a local LLM, computes dynamic SLA urgency, escalates critical tickets to a human-in-the-loop Expo mobile dashboard, and sends approved (or AI-auto) replies back through the original channel. The system is grounded in each tenant's own knowledge base and out-of-scope questions defer to a human.

items.title: Movie Insight Using React Flask
items.description: This project is a portfolio demonstrating the application of React, Flask, and TypeScript to build a movie insight system. The application uses caching with LRU cache to optimize performance and provides an interface for users to view movies and their insights.
